subject.title: Feature: Expose OpenRouter usage cost to agent runtime

question: What provider-reported cost metadata contract should OpenClaw expose for OpenRouter responses, and which runtime/session surfaces should consume it?
rationale: This affects stable agent/runtime metadata, session status semantics, provider-cost precedence, and plugin/channel consumption, so automation should not choose the public API shape without maintainer direction.

options.title: Add Exact-Cost Metadata Contract
options.body: Expose OpenRouter provider-reported cost as additive structured metadata with source, units, raw details, and fallback-to-estimate behavior while keeping `estimatedCostUsd` distinct.

options.title: Fold Into Broader Usage Ledger
options.body: Defer implementation until the per-call usage ledger and `session_status` usage API define one shared contract for exact and estimated costs.

options.title: Keep Exact Cost Outside Core
options.body: Leave core on local estimates and require exact OpenRouter accounting to live in a plugin or external ledger surface.

recommendation.title: Add Exact-Cost Metadata Contract
recommendation.body: Expose OpenRouter provider-reported cost as additive structured metadata with source, units, raw details, and fallback-to-estimate behavior while keeping `estimatedCostUsd` distinct.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest current-history signal across OpenRouter billed-cost reconciliation, OpenAI-compatible usage parsing, and session cost persistence.
